sources.title: Naga City Tourism: Plaza Jorge Barlin
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: The plaza honors Jorge Barlin, the first Filipino consecrated as a Roman Catholic bishop.
Barlin was born in Baao, Camarines Sur in 1850.
He was consecrated bishop on June 29, 1906.
The monument stands at the corner of Barlin Street, formerly Calle Elcano, and Arana Street.
